notes.title: Lil' Demo Update
notes.content:
The demo has been updated with some improvements!

[list]
[*] Advanced Training has been tweaked to be more forgiving. People were having more trouble with that than most of the other stages, which was clearly not ideal. The tutorials will see more changes in the future.
[*] Point of Impact has had some geometry adjustments around a couple of annoying spots. Nothing that'll seriously affect most runs, though. (Some of these happened a couple of silent patches ago, but don't worry about it.)
[*] The HUD now displays key collection progress in applicable stages. This uses the tutorial text element right now, but that'll probably change at some point.
[*] Key beams now disappear once the goal has been opened to improve clarity.
[*] Some tutorial messages have been reworded to better convey what they actually meant.
[*] Behavior for preventing the camera from clipping through level geometry has been improved. It still isn't perfect, but you should at least see beyond the veil less often.
[*] Fixed gamepad look being disabled during the countdown at the start of a run.
[/list]

In the future I may reset leaderboards for certain stages if the top runs wouldn't be replicable due to changes made in a patch, but they won't be touched this update since nothing relevant was affected. For the record, I'll keep updating the demo as I work on the full game so it's reasonably current with improvements made there, and it'll remain available up to and after launch. Its leaderboards are separate from the retail version's, though.

Have fun!

notes.title: AVENGE MYSELF Next Fest Demo now available!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45233706/8aa1fc1af97827a1c39db3265d65c3566300f076.jpg[/img]

[b]The Next Fest demo for AVENGE MYSELF is now available![/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3488520/AVENGE_MYSELF_Demo/

Enjoy a taste of AVENGE MYSELF's gameplay with two stages from the full game and a miniature hub world full of extra events.

The demo content includes:
[list]
[*] 2 main stages (each with 4 medal times to shoot for)
[*] 2 tutorial stages
[*] A special mini hub world with 3 additional events
[*] Steam achievements and leaderboard support
[*] Proper key rebinding (yes, you can separate boosting from the jump button now, you're welcome)
[/list]
[b]If you enjoy the demo, please leave a review for it and share it around![/b] It'd help a lot. While the demo may be for Next Fest, it's not going anywhere; I'll update it every now and then throughout development.
